sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: A record read by a person shows its title as a heading and its meaning in words, without machine fields.

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: SP-82: rendered documents cannot keep a continuous heading outline; decision 444121a6 sends srs#911 to an RFC. SP-80: the rendered specification cannot be followed front to back (cluster 426561fe); the spec's reading order work (unit 2e876361) and one mechanism for depth (65c41ce6) answered parts of it. SP-05 and srs#928: labels belong in the core, not invented by clients; compositions have no display title. Practised in LiveWyer: displayLabel on every field and a reading view per type (title as heading, machine fields hidden).

sections.name: principle
sections.label: Principle
sections.content: Every type has a reading view; documents keep a continuous outline. Practised; ruled to an RFC (444121a6) but not written.
